title: Her father's birth year
summary: Her father died in 1961 at 80, so he was born in about 1881.

blocks.x: You mentioned the other day that you weren't sure when exactly your father was born, what his birth year might have been. You said you could probably figure it out.
You know, I didn't think about it, Pat, but --

But my dad, let's see. My dad died in 1961 and he was 80, he was 80 when he died. So we'll have to figure that out. Now, I haven't even had time. I didn't even think about it anymore. I should have made a note of that.
